title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19840 missing authorization allowed guests to add issues to sprints…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack before version 2026.2.19840 allowed unauthenticated guest users to add issues to sprints due to missing authorization checks. This issue has a low severity rating with limited impact on integrity and no impact on confidentiality or availability.
